content: Men Tafaram Bairi Kwani’of
Kwa wanawanamaim iti gamin baiyow ana ef i menane na kwagam kwabiyow? Iti sawar etei i kwa a naniyanane enan, biya ana yasisir isan, naatu nati sawar i mar etei wanawanamaim in gamin ekukura’ara’ah.

A kok gagamin i sawar kwatabow, baise men kwabowabow. Sabuw kwa’a’asbunubunuw naatu kwababahiy kwanekwan, baise abisa kwakokok men kwabowabow. Naatu abisa men kwabaib isan kwagam kwabiyow, anayabin God men kwabifefeyan.
God kwabifefeyan men ibit, anayabin sawar kwa akis a yasisir isan kwakok kwabifefeyan, nati fefeyan i men gewasin.
Baiwa’an kwanekwaneyah tak! Tafaram bairi kwai’of God ana rakit kwamamatar kwaso’ob ai en? Orot yait tafaram ana of emamatar i taiyuwin iwa’an God ana rakit matar.
Men kwananot tur iti Bukamaim eo i yabin en. “God Anun Kakafiyin wanawanatamaim yari’iy ema’am, abisa kakafin tasisinaf isan ana yaso’ar i gagamin maiyow ebaib.
Baise manaw kabeber Godane i gagamin na’in ebitit. Buk Atamaninamaim eo na’atube,

content.text: baise sabuw iyab teyayara’iyih i manaw kabeber ebitih.”

content: Isan imih taiyuw God kwanitin. Naatu Demon Mowan kwanarukouw, saise i boro nabihir kwa nihamiyi.
Kwanan God biyanamaim kwaniyubin, i boro nan kwa biyamaim niyubin, kwa i bowabow kakafin wairafi, imih uma kwanasouwen, naatu dogor kwanasouwen, kwa wanawan rerekabih.
A kakafih isan kwaniyababan, kwanarerey kwana’osmetan, marib keteketef kwanihamiy kwanarerey. Naatu kawasa kwanihamiy kwaniyababan.
Naatu au’uwi maiye Regah nanamaim taiyuw kwanayara’iyi, Regah boro kwa nabora’ahi.
Baibatiyenayan Ana Baimatnuwen

Taitu, men asir taiyuw wanawanamaim kwanagam, kwanigigim, kwana’uwi kwanikwaniyimih. O yait Kirisiyan tura isan igam iu naatu kubibabatiy, o i ofafar isan kugamigim naatu kubibabatiy. Imih o kubibatiy ana veya o i men ofafar kubobosiyasiyar, baise ana baibatiyenayan imatar.
God akisinamo ofafar ebitit naatu i akisinamo nibatiyit, i akisinamo boro niyawasit naatu i akisinamo boro nagurusit. Baise o a gewasin i men tomar taituwa kubibatiy?
Maras Isan Men Inaora’ara’at
Iti ao kwananowar, o yait iti na’at inao, “Boun o maras it boro tanan tafaram ta gagamin, imaim kwamur ta’imon tanama tanabow kabay tanab ata kabay tafan tanaya’abar.”
Baise maras ayawas isan abisa namamatar o men iso’ob. Kwa i sowasow na’atube, mar auman sowasow i’itin, mar kafai in veya nayey sowasow na’am in.
Baise ana gewasin kwa iti na’atube kwatao, God nakokok na’at basit tanama sawar iti o ni’i tanasinaf.
Baise kwa i bai’o’orotoyah naatu ora’ara’atayah, nati a ora’ara’at etei i kakafih.
Isan imih orot yait sawar gewasin so’ob baise men isisinaf, nati orot i bowabow kakafin isisinaf.
